integrity: An analytic proof using monomial norms, Enestrom-Kakeya, Hurwitz, a classical Ramanujan sum, winding numbers and logarithmic derivatives. Numerical checks are non-exhaustive. The originality assessment is comparative and not a formal priority certification.
scientific_limitations: The zero count concerns one-sided two-circle Hardy reproducing kernels and every fixed scalar radius a<r<1 as N tends to infinity, not the boundary layer approaching |s|=1. No simplicity, convergence rates or uniformity in a is asserted; prior literature may contain equivalent theta finite-section results.
title: A logarithmic zero cloud for two-circle Hardy reproducing kernels
